description: This header file defines the interface for inter-process communication (IPC) with a Git file system monitor daemon. It declares functions to check support, retrieve the IPC path, determine daemon state, send queries about file changes, and send commands to the daemon.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__is_supported
methods.description: Checks if the built-in file system monitor daemon is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the IPC named pipe or Unix domain socket for the daemon, specific to the current repository.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__get_state
methods.description: Determines whether the `git-fsmonitor--daemon` process is active and listening for IPC connections.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_query
methods.description: Connects to the daemon via simple-ipc and retrieves changed files since a given token.

methods.name: fsmonitor_ipc__send_command
methods.description: Sends a command verb to the daemon via simple-ipc without attempting to start the daemon.

calls: simple-ipc.h functions (not explicitly specified in the header but implied by context)
